# ZKK Consulting

> ZKK Consulting LLC is a two-person Texas consulting firm for engineering-led products. It provides fixed-price market research, patent landscape research, competitive pricing analysis and strategy research for startups and medical device teams. Business and market research only: not legal, regulatory, medical, tax, accounting or investment advice, and not billing or coding guidance.

## Services and pricing

- [Services and pricing](https://zkkconsulting.com/services/): Launchpad $2,500, Growth $4,500, Comprehensive $7,500, Patent Landscape $2,000, bundles from $3,999
- [Patent landscape analysis for startups](https://zkkconsulting.com/patent-landscape-research/): up to 15 patents, $2,000, business research only
- [Medical device patent landscape research](https://zkkconsulting.com/medical-device-patent-landscape/): $2,000 for up to 15 identified patents
- [Medical device competitive landscape analysis](https://zkkconsulting.com/medical-device-competitive-landscape/): Launchpad package, $2,500
- [Market sizing for startups](https://zkkconsulting.com/market-sizing-for-startups/): TAM, SAM and SOM in the $4,500 Growth package
- [What market research costs for a startup](https://zkkconsulting.com/services/#prices): fixed prices, terms and what drives cost
- [Medical device and electronics expertise](https://zkkconsulting.com/expertise/): FDA, FCC and engineering-heavy markets
